entities.summary: "Et si tu n'existais pas" is a 1975 song by Joe Dassin. It is the first track of his album Joe Dassin . The lyrics are by Pierre Delanoë and Claude Lemesle, the music is by Salvatore Cutugno and Pasquale Losito. The song was covered by Iggy Pop in 2012.
